definition: Xu Li is a Chinese computer scientist and co-founder and current CEO of SenseTime, an artificial intelligence (AI) company.
details: Xu has led SenseTime since the company's incorporation and helped it independently develop its proprietary deep learning platform.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Xu Li (computer scientist) — a small key that opens a big door.
